notes.title: Patch 1.15
notes.notes: [h2]Patchnotes[/h2][p]- Fixed a single 'stuck' spot in front of camp ridge. The ol' put a rock there trick.[/p][p] - Fixed CTD because of pathing in 'Camp Ridge' Scene, though the underlying issue was global. Cheeky little null check fixed everything forever. [/p][p]- Engine version update for Godot from 3.~ to 4.4.[/p][p]- Simplified the occlusion mesh on 'Borros Garden' scene for performance.[/p][p]- Misc typo fixes. [/p][p]- Texture Mipmap bias changed from 0.0 to -2.0, Sharper image quality on nearby textures and less UV bleeding. Hugely impactful to the image quality, in my opinion.[/p]

notes.title: The Very Large Very Good Burrow Wing pricedrop
notes.notes: [p]Plummeting down from 14.99 US, Burrow Wing will now tempt your wallet at an earnest and homely price point of 3.99.[/p][p]Now obviously you and your slightly heavier wallet [i]are[/i] happy about this, soft product consumer. What about [i]me[/i] though? Why would I do this? [/p][p][/p][p]I'm making more games, for one - I want the back catalogue priced like its a back catalogue. Burrow Wing was the first commercial product I've put out, and I love it dearly. A lower price means more people can play, and heightens the impact of my tiny little storefront here on the steam marketplace. I think the lower price also justifies some of the sharper edges and messy code in the game too, between you and me. A learning experience. [/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, the game is cheaper! Enjoy. [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/EW6tzvi.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:
[h3]Patchnotes[/h3]

- New micro-dungeon area! Bargale Ruins, the entrance is near to the Worldspring entrance. 
- Thats literally all. Only two patchnotes. Absolutely disgraceful.

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.notes:
Hi gamers. This is the 13th patch pushed to steam.

[h3]Patchnotes[/h3]
- Fixed cavecrab not dealing damage.
- Gave Tutreetial more roots and a brighter eye (testers kept walking past him, unaware!).
- Fixed a bug allowing the shield to be active while unequipped.
- Lowered the render distance of all static props for performance, plus added some I missed to the list.
- Crates. Crates in the grave. Sorry.
- Minor dialogue changes to help with players missing Tutreetial.
- A few other tiny quality of life changes.


[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
- The entire Burrow Wing OST is now available on Youtube.
